purpose: Correct the V1 rescue version drift, repair the shared post-retrieval execution layer before any new fit, and qualify profile-only MP and atomic MS as parallel memory-head candidates while preserving RS and treating ME as a sparse optional head.

supersedes.reason: V1 incorrectly deferred all MP even though the frozen paper plan had already removed MP_PREFERENCE, retained MP_PROFILE, and the P2 atomic design contained a usable profile-personalization minimum. V1 also described role-aware composition as more complete than the implemented executor actually was.

evidence_bindings.use: same-stack evidence that forced MS use and fallback reduced quality
component minima and prospective response-use boundaries; its four axes are retained as a decision checklist, not as four statistically independent gold labels
evidence that independent per-axis reviewer gates failed because the axes are logically coupled
frozen scope that trains MP_PROFILE and excludes MP_PREFERENCE
partial role taxonomy and requested-to-feasible projection to be superseded by the component-general V3 executor

paper_success_requirement.preferred_result: RS plus both MP_PROFILE and MS qualify; ME is reported at the level supported by real typed action-result coverage
paper_success_requirement.minimum_result: RS plus at least one memory head produces cross-fitted routing signal and verified same-stack functional memory contribution without worse material risk or unacceptable quality loss
paper_success_requirement.failure_condition: RS is the only functioning learned head, or every memory head remains fixed OFF or lacks end-to-end functional contribution

scope_correction.MP: MP_PROFILE means Profile-based Personalization only. Preference is removed from Paper 1 and must not re-enter candidate generation, features, labels, prompts, metrics, or claims.
scope_correction.profile_is_not_identity_feature: The low-capacity PM may see profile field type, scope-fit, novelty, age, retrieval score/margin, and bounded constraint/applicability indicators; it may not memorize the user's name, exact job, location, nationality, gender, or raw profile value as an identity shortcut.
scope_correction.profile_presence_is_not_gold: A profile item is ON only when it can materially change a response constraint, logistical detail, framing choice, or relevant premise now. Merely restating the profile is OFF.

root_cause_disposition.resolution: Freeze an atomic actual Rank-1 item and label that exact item. Session/event lineage remains provenance and split metadata, never a positive suitability label.

Use component-specific suitability decisions that require a concrete prospective use plan and reject current semantic echoes, generic topical overlap, stale facts, and facts that would not change the reply.

The exact source remains audit evidence. A deterministic realization step converts it into an owner/time-tagged meaning cue plus an allowed use mode; the generator must synthesize rather than quote or splice it.

A shared V3 planner assigns one primary discourse act, silent modifiers, optional continuity/option roles, pairwise compatibility, response-act budget, and deterministic suppression before one coherent generation call.

Do not use influenced_by as worth-opening gold. Create prospective exact-candidate suitability labels from runtime-visible state plus exact candidate; keep the graph evaluator-only for provenance and grouping.

Use one binary component-specific suitability/function decision with anchored positive, hard-negative, and boundary examples plus reason codes. The old four axes are a checklist and evidence record, not four independent pass gates. Requested, generator-claimed, and independently verified use remain separate.

Use low-capacity models, connected-group outer folds, identity-free features, proper scores, owner-cluster intervals, and same-stack baselines. Do not inflate independence with sessions, wrappers, ES-MemEval copies, or synthetic users. This limits claim precision, not whether a head can be trained.

Remove lexical-use requirements; preserve safe current-grounded replies on non-use; regenerate without contaminated personal evidence only for actual owner/time/scaffold violations; measure remaining generator errors separately.

head_program.head: RS
head_program.reason: The grouped OOF routing result already passed. RS remains the sole primary response act when ON and participates in the same V3 composition and baseline stack.

head_program.head: MP_PROFILE
head_program.reason: EvoEmo supplies explicit profile records and the frozen P1B surface has 846 MP execution candidates. Profile type/scope and current applicability provide a bounded, identity-free personalization problem. Presence alone is insufficient, so prospective material-transformation labels are still required.
head_program.minimum: The profile fact silently changes at least one response constraint, logistical detail, framing choice, or materially relevant premise.

head_program.head: MS
head_program.reason: The prior V2 model showed borderline discrimination and execution enrichment, but the session-level label and forced-use executor were wrong. Atomic exact-candidate suitability and meaning absorption directly target the observed failures.
head_program.minimum: One verified strictly-prior user-owned fact or episode adds nonredundant continuity that changes understanding of or action on the current issue.

head_program.head: ME
head_program.reason: Typed action-result has a clear function but only 417 execution candidates and limited cross-group positive support. Audit real typed coverage before any label or fit; do not invent events to rescue prevalence.
head_program.minimum: A verified past user action-result pair supports one tentative, declinable present option without implying a rule, cause, or guaranteed repeat.

suitability_gold_v2.unit: one current runtime-visible state plus one frozen actual Rank-1 atomic candidate for one component
suitability_gold_v2.primary_label: one binary SUITABLE or NOT_SUITABLE decision, with SEMANTIC_ABSTAIN mapped to runtime OFF and reported as coverage
decision_checklist_not_independent_targe: component minimum can be realized now
suitability_gold_v2.reason_for_single_gold: The four checklist questions are logically coupled. Requiring independent per-axis agreement recreated the P2B measurement failure and is forbidden.
suitability_gold_v2.label_source: machine-resolved structural facts plus anchored source-aware human adjudication of the single component-specific decision; an LLM may assist only after a human-human calibration passes and may never silently replace unresolved human cases
suitability_gold_v2.actual_rank1_freeze: Retrieval query, candidate pool, atomic segmentation, ranker, score, tie-break, and Rank-1 identity are frozen before semantic labels are read.

pipeline: one primary discourse act plus bounded modifiers

joint_projection.one_primary_act: Exactly one of RS or R0 owns the reply's primary discourse act.
joint_projection.MP_with_any: MP may coexist only as a silent modifier and only when it changes the chosen act without restatement, stereotype, or conflict.
joint_projection.MS_with_ME: Default to one explicit memory contribution. Both may coexist only when a frozen outcome-blind relation says they form one coherent chain and total burden remains within budget; UNKNOWN, REDUNDANT, or CONFLICT suppresses the lower-priority item deterministically.
joint_projection.MS_with_RS: MS may supply context to the RS act but may not create a second question, second interpretation task, or competing advice act.
joint_projection.ME_with_RS: If RS already offers a micro-step, ME cannot add a second option unless the two are explicitly the same act; otherwise one is suppressed.
joint_projection.response_budget: One primary act, at most one explicit memory contribution, and at most one low-burden invitation. MP consumes no visible act but must produce an auditable response-choice delta.

meaning_absorption: Exact candidate text remains in the audit packet but is presented to the generator as source evidence, never as prose to insert.
No component requires literal mention or lexical overlap.
First-person user text must never be copied into the assistant voice.
The generator may omit a memory cue that does not naturally improve the current-grounded reply; omission downgrades the realized component to OFF and is not a quality failure by itself.
Generator telemetry is a claim of attempted use, not proof of function.

guard_and_fallback.safe_nonuse: Keep the current-grounded reply, record requested ON / feasible ON / generator-claimed OFF, and do not replace it with a generic fallback.
guard_and_fallback.owner_time_scaffold_contamination: Discard the contaminated reply and run at most one frozen regeneration with the contaminated personal component removed while preserving any independently safe RS act.
guard_and_fallback.transport_or_schema_failure: Apply the same transport fallback and accounting to every policy and baseline.
guard_and_fallback.offline_function: Only a blinded source-aware reviewer can mark verified component function; lexical overlap and telemetry cannot.

required_machine_invariants: no requires_literal_mention for MP, MS, or ME
no lexical overlap requirement for function or guard success
no safe non-use converted into fixed generic M0 output
no exact user first-person candidate copied into assistant reply
no cross-component evidence union without an explicit pair relation
RS remains the only primary act when ON
requested, structurally eligible, planned, generator-claimed, and offline-verified action bits are stored separately
all 16 requested actions traverse the same projector and executor in tests

atomic-resource rather than parent-session gold unit
single suitability decision rather than independent-axis gate
component roles and all-pair composition requirements
meaning absorption instead of hard splice
safe non-use versus actual safety contamination

profile-only MP actual Rank-1 realization and labels
irreducible_limits: incomplete author lineage as suitability truth
bounded rather than unrestricted semantic understanding

next_authorized_sequence_after_independe: Implement and test the shared component-general V3 realization, planner, generator program, guard, and telemetry separation with zero API calls; test all 16 requested actions and every component pair.

Run a zero-API surface audit for MP_PROFILE, atomic MS, and typed ME: candidate counts, owner groups, profile-field/action-result coverage, negative-family coverage, feature leakage, and current-echo rates.
Freeze identity-free feature schemas and one binary anchored suitability packet for MP_PROFILE and MS; qualify ME only if real coverage supports bidirectional grouped learning.

Create labels once, then run one grouped OOF per eligible head. Preserve RS; qualify any memory head that shows nontrivial cross-fitted discrimination, proper-score gain, ON/OFF support, and negative-family coverage without post-result tuning.
Before paid scale-up, validate V3 on a small hand-confirmed eligible/ineligible executor packet for absorption, function, boundary safety, and safe non-use.
Run one frozen 16-action same-stack comparison of learned qualified, RS-only, always-off, fixed-high eligible, transparent rule, cost-matched fixed, and on-rate-matched random policies.
Report ESConv routing/support, EvoEmo longitudinal personalization/continuity, and ES-MemEval QA transport as three complementary tracks.
